name: @epoch-dev/workspace
description: Epoch: a local-first desktop app that turns a codebase into a dependency graph with blast radius, risk tiers and dead-feature alerts.

scripts.dev: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/app^... --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @epoch-dev/app dev
scripts.package: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/app... --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @epoch-dev/app package:installer
scripts.package:dir: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/app... --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @epoch-dev/app package:dir
scripts.lint: prettier --check . && eslint eslint.config.mjs scripts && node scripts/gen-queries.mjs --check && node scripts/turbo.mjs run lint
scripts.test: node scripts/turbo.mjs run test && pnpm test:scripts
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.bench: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/bench... --output-logs=errors-only && node packages/bench/dist/perf.js
scripts.bench:accuracy: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/bench... --output-logs=errors-only && node packages/bench/dist/accuracy.js
scripts.bench:accuracy-go: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/bench... --output-logs=errors-only && node packages/bench/dist/accuracy-go.js
scripts.bench:accuracy-python: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/bench... --output-logs=errors-only && node packages/bench/dist/accuracy-python.js
scripts.bench:watch: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/bench... --output-logs=errors-only && node packages/bench/dist/watch-latency.js
scripts.bench:findings: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/bench... --output-logs=errors-only && node packages/bench/dist/findings.js
scripts.bench:findings:score: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/bench... --output-logs=errors-only && node packages/bench/dist/findings-score.js
scripts.bench:scorers: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/bench... --output-logs=errors-only && node packages/bench/dist/scorers.js
scripts.bench:risk: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/bench... --output-logs=errors-only && node packages/bench/dist/risk.js
scripts.bench:summaries: node scripts/turbo.mjs run build --filter=@epoch-dev/bench... --output-logs=errors-only && node packages/bench/dist/summaries.js
